name: Watanabe Takahiro
source:
President of Yaesaka's student council, a second-year student who is also captain of the kendo club. Sachiho's childhood friend. Owns a sword passed down from generation to generation, for self-defense. Distrustful of Hatsune.

Edited from [url=http://alicesoft.wikia.com/wiki/Atlach-Nacha]AliceSoftWikia[/url]
